meta.title: Model Connection Test
meta.description: Adds a connection-test panel under Settings -> Models: one minimal chat round-trip per configured model, with failure codes and first-output/total latency. Credentials never leave the Host process.

panelIntro: Sends one minimal chat request ("ping", small output cap) per model to verify connectivity with a real request. Latency numbers indicate magnitude only.
